bpm.name: BPM
bpm.description: Enter the song's BPM to make gameplay sync.

use-player-clicks.name: Use player clicks
use-player-clicks.description: If enabled, the gameplay will form around your clicks. If not, clicks will be inserted at random.

sync-offset.name: Sync offset
sync-offset.description: Seconds added to the start time so objects line up with the music beat.

beat-chance.name: Beat chance
beat-chance.description: Chance of placing an object on each beat.

half-beat-chance.name: Half beat chance
half-beat-chance.description: Chance of placing an object on each half beat. Flying gamemodes always place.

place-again-chance.name: Place again chance
place-again-chance.description: Chance of placing a follow-up object shortly after a portal or spider tap.

tap-balance-start.name: Starting tap balance
tap-balance-start.description: Positive values delay the first jump; negative values encourage jumping straight away.

random-tap-chance.name: Tap chance on beat
random-tap-chance.description: Chance that a beat-placed object requires a tap or hold.

mash-toggle-chance.name: Mash toggle chance
mash-toggle-chance.description: Chance of toggling the jump button each check while mashing (ship/wave random).

tap-hold-frames.name: Tap hold frames
tap-hold-frames.description: How many frames a normal tap is held before release.

hold-min-seconds.name: Min random hold
hold-min-seconds.description: Shortest hold, in seconds, for robot-style random holds.

hold-max-seconds.name: Max random hold
hold-max-seconds.description: Longest hold, in seconds, for robot-style random holds.

spike-margin.name: Spike margin
spike-margin.description: Controls how close the spikes are to the player. Lower values make the gameplay less forgiving.

camera-free-mode.name: Free camera
camera-free-mode.description: Enables free mode for gamemode portals.

experimental-gameplay.name: Experimental gameplay
experimental-gameplay.description: Adds experimental variations to existing gameplay elements, such as late ring timings and jump pads while flying.

portal-frequency.name: Portal frequency
portal-frequency.description: Multiplier on portal selection weight. 0 disables portals, 1 is default.

special-frequency.name: Pad and ring frequency
special-frequency.description: Multiplier on pad and ring selection weight. 0 disables them, 1 is default.

bounds-safety.name: Bounds safety
bounds-safety.description: Scales how far from the floor/ceiling the cube and robot stay before high jumps are avoided. Higher is safer.

center-bias.name: Center bias
center-bias.description: How strongly bounded gamemodes steer toward the middle of the play area.

terminal-velocity-guard.name: Terminal velocity guard
terminal-velocity-guard.description: Falling speed at which the generator forces a catching object (cube/ball).

blind-jump-distance.name: Blind jump distance
blind-jump-distance.description: Vertical travel in the last moments beyond which taps are avoided in random mode.

blind-scan-seconds.name: Blind scan window
blind-scan-seconds.description: Seconds of history used for the blind jump check.

debug-trail.name: Debug trail
debug-trail.description: Leaves an object trail behind the player while generating. An X indicates the jump button is pressed.
